results.note: empty-step guard neutered: a split token is never None, so an empty step (e.g. --ai ',deep' or 'x,,deep') passes through instead of being refused.
wrong string in the refusal sentence: the corrective spelling it offers names <file> instead of <rung>, misdirecting the person to a spelling that does not exist.
boundary flip in the plural: zero clean lines now prints '0 line' instead of '0 lines'.
default --ai-scope rung raised from 1 to 2: a plan that never passed --ai-scope now lets the deep step reach neighbours by default instead of stopping at the file.
